purpose: Five replacement achievement seals requested by the owner

files.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production-ready square achievement-seal illustration for NefroQuest, a refined dark medieval nephrology learning RPG. This is a new artwork, replacing an overly colorful trading-card style. Family art direction: a substantial circular heraldic medallion in aged brass and antique gold, sculpted high-relief central symbol, restrained dark petrol enamel and tiny teal highlights. Midnight navy background (#09111b) with very subtle atmospheric texture. Rich tactile metal, minute engraved craftsmanship, sharp readable silhouette, elegant museum-quality relic, dramatic soft light from upper left and faint cool rim light. Front facing, centered, entire medallion visible, fills 82% of square with breathing room. The circular rim is thin and architectural, not jewel-encrusted. Matte shadowed recesses, balanced subdued contrast. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no rectangular trading-card frame, no rainbow jewels, no neon, no cartoon, no UI mockup. Render detailed bitmap artwork that remains recognizable at 136px and beautiful at 280px. Subject for seal 1, Vórtice do Néfron: a single kidney-shaped polished antique gold emblem with a small intricately sculpted spiral at its center, surrounded by two restrained curling currents engraved into petrol enamel. A symbol of the beginning of mastery. Simple coherent anatomy-inspired abstraction, decorative rather than a medical diagram. Rim detailing is understated concentric engraving. Strong kidney silhouette is the focal point.
